Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Dela Rosa’s arrest? NBI hopes by year-end

blocks.text: The National Bureau of Investigation says it hopes Senator Bato dela Rosa would be arrested before the end of the year.

items: Senate impeachment court admits prosecution evidence in Sara Duterte trial

blocks.text: The Senate impeachment court overrules the defense’s objections to the documentary evidence presented by the prosecution in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial.

items: Unemployment edges up to 5.4% in September 2026

blocks.text: The Philippine Statistics Authority reports, unemployment rose slightly to 5.4% in September 2026, which means 2.86 million Filipinos were jobless last month.

items: A nuclear reactor inside Pax Silica? DOE says it’s an option

blocks.text: Department of Energy Director IV Patrick Aquino says it is an option for the power-hungry Pax Silica industrial hub to go nuclear.

items: Eala takes down Antonia Ružić in Hong Kong open quarterfinals

blocks.text: Filipino tennis star Alex Eala takes down Croatia’s Antonia Ružić in the quarterfinals of the 2026 Hong Kong Tennis Open. – Rappler.com
